basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old IT specialist living in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. A die-hard Green Bay Packers fan, I spend my weekends cheering on my team with friends and family. During the week, I work remotely as a systems analyst, focusing on privacy and security solutions for businesses. I'm married to my college sweetheart, and we enjoy cooking together and exploring local hiking trails. I'm usually online in the evenings after work hours. I have a strong dislike for invasive software and always look for privacy-friendly alternatives.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin. My expertise lies in network security and privacy solutions. I've built this knowledge through both formal education and a decade of working in the IT industry. I'm a big advocate for open-source software and regularly contribute to privacy-focused projects.
